verse.verse_1: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
verse.verse_2: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
verse.verse_3: And man saith: What aileth her?
verse.verse_4: That day she will relate her chronicles,
verse.verse_6: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
verse.verse_8: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
